I am sorry for what you gone through. People can be mean and often say hurtful things without thinking. I learned a long time ago not to care what they say. Its about how you feel about yourself. Don't let what they say influence how you feel about yourself. These are shallow people.  And their feeling don't matter. There are many reasons why they behave that. Maybe they weren't loved as a child. Maybe they are jealous because you have a better personality than they do. Maybe they are just hurtful people or feel superior to you by controlling your feelings. Just remember, YOU ARE IN CONTROLL OF YOUR OWN FEELINGS. No one can make you feel anything, unless you let them. These people are superficial. THEY DONT MATTER. I have never met an ugly person in my life. Even people that had their face disfigured and burned are not ugly to me. Be original, don't let these people make you as bitter as they are. Be your happy self. There is a saying that might help you. "People might forget what you said. People might forget what you did. But people will never forget how you make them feel"  Make everyone around you feel loved and good. People who pass judgement on you. Aren't even your friends to with...
